Create a polished, realistic flat UI design frame for the existing NUK Cafe admin app. This is a proposed product screen, not a marketing landing page. Match Nuxt UI v4 default components: white and warm stone-gray surfaces, thin neutral borders, very subtle rounded corners, compact Inter-like sans-serif type, plain outline Lucide-like icons, dark amber/brown primary buttons with WHITE text, pale amber warnings with dark readable text, green only for success. NO gradients, glass, dramatic shadows, oversized controls, decorative illustrations, AI robot imagery or generic blue/purple AI styling. English UI copy, sentence case. Crisp readable text. Keep model names, Cloudflare, technical architecture, retention policy and confidence percentages OUT of product UI. No automatic publishing. App identity at sidebar top is a simple coffee icon with 'NUK Cafe' and a small chevron; selected navigation is Menu items. Other navigation: Dashboard; Menu group with Menu items, Categories, Options, Add-ons, Availability; Reports; Admin group with Cafe profile, Staff, Branch, Payments, Telegram; footer View menu, Assistant, Sokha / Owner. Show true software layout, not a photograph of a computer. Use modest compact controls and generous spacing between sections.
Output ONE desktop screen in landscape, representing a 1440 by 960 desktop frame. Left sidebar roughly 220px, main app navbar with breadcrumb 'Menu items / Import menu' and small 'Cancel' at far right. Main title 'Import menu', subtitle 'Turn a menu image or PDF into drafts you can review.' Horizontal understated numbered stepper '1 Upload' active, '2 Review', '3 Drafts'.
Main content is a centered medium width card about 760px. Top a dashed upload area with document outline icon, text 'Drop a menu image or PDF here', outlined 'Choose file', and supporting 'JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF'. Below, selected file row with PDF icon 'cafe-menu.pdf', '2.4 MB · 3 pages', a small remove X. Next section 'Choose pages' with small 'Select all' control and THREE portrait thumbnail previews of paper cafe menus side by side, each checkbox CHECKED and captions 'Page 1', 'Page 2', 'Page 3'. Source previews use real readable coffee-menu headings where feasible, no cropped random stock pictures. Footer of the card says '3 pages selected'. Below is a muted small note 'You’ll review every item before creating drafts.' At bottom-right of the card a dark amber primary button 'Extract menu' with right arrow. Lower on the main page simple 'For better results' helper bullets: 'Use a clear, straight photo.' and 'Keep item names and prices visible.' Sidebar and app shell remain understated. The file is selected and the action is enabled. No green completed state on this screen. Include a small OUTSIDE-the-product annotation in the canvas margin '01 · Upload and choose pages'.

Heading 'Review extracted items', subtitle 'Check names, categories and prices against your menu.' Stepper '1 Upload' completed, '2 Review' active, '3 Drafts' upcoming.
The main content has a clear side-by-side source/review composition: left source card approximately 380px wide, right review list approximately 720px. Left source header 'cafe-menu.pdf', secondary 'Page 1 of 3', small zoom icons and a page navigation control. Below white paper portrait source preview titled 'NUK CAFE' then 'Coffee & tea', realistic extracted source lines: Iced latte $3.50; Americano $2.50; Cappuccino $3.25; Matcha latte $4.00; Chocolate latte $3.?5. Thin amber rectangle highlights the unclear price in the document, not all rows. Left bottom muted 'Compare each item with the source.'
Right review header '6 items found', chips/counts '4 ready' and '2 need attention', neutral buttons 'Select ready' and 'Clear selection'. Pale amber compact alert: '2 items need attention' with supporting 'Check an unclear price and a possible duplicate.' Table columns: checkbox, Item, Category, Price, Review, edit icon. Six rows, exactly:
checked Iced latte | Coffee | $3.50 | Ready
checked Americano | Coffee | $2.50 | Ready
checked Cappuccino | Coffee | $3.25 | Ready
checked Matcha latte | Tea | $4.00 | Ready
unchecked Chocolate latte | Coffee | — | Check price (amber)
unchecked Iced latte | Coffee | $3.50 | Possible duplicate (amber).
The possible duplicate row shows subtle secondary 'Matches an existing item'. The checked rows look editable with neat compact category picker fields and price inputs; do not fill the whole table with colorful pills. Small source page references under names if readable. Below table note 'Unchecked items won’t be created.' Bottom of main content, a fixed subtle border-top action bar '4 items selected' on left, secondary 'Back', primary dark amber 'Create 4 drafts' on right. Beneath or above action bar muted note 'Drafts stay hidden from customers until you publish them.' This is a proposal, not already saved. Do not show any Publish button. Include a small OUTSIDE-the-product caption in canvas margin '02 · Review against the source'.
